LESSON: GOOD GROOMING CLEANING

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: AGRICULTURE
Strand: HYGIENE PRACTICES Strand Sub strand Specific learning outcomes Suggested learnin
Topic 3.1: Good Grooming cleaning

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Good Grooming cleaning
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How does body cleanliness enhance personal hygiene?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. describe practices that enhance body cleanliness
2. practice body cleanliness as a healthy habit

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Good Grooming cleaning

Teach
• Observe Good Grooming cleaning in real life (school compound, home, farm).
• Use safe examples only.
• Name → explain → apply.

Worked example
• Fact 1 about Good Grooming cleaning (in pupil words).
• Fact 2 with a Kenyan example.
• Safe action connected to Good Grooming cleaning.

Try this
• Draw/label one diagram for Good Grooming cleaning.
• Write 5 bullet facts about Good Grooming cleaning.
• Say one safety rule.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• describe practices that enhance body cleanliness
• practice body cleanliness as a healthy habit

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. List 8 facts on Good Grooming cleaning.
2. Teach a friend using only bullet points.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet for Good Grooming cleaning: meaning, diagram, 5 practice questions.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How does body cleanliness enhance personal hygiene?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• describe practices that enhance body cleanliness
• practice body cleanliness as a healthy habit

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
